brief: docs/REVISION-2.md (overrides docs/BRIEF.md); camera and mark rules in src/camera.ts and scripts/check-marks.ts

target.url: set by APP_URL (default http://localhost:4173): the local stack from stand-in/up.sh, or the live app

film_patient.name: Siti Contoh
film_patient.name_note: "Contoh" is Malay for "example": unique, plainly invented to a Malaysian viewer, and still reads as a name on screen. Searched for before registering; never reused from another visitor.
film_patient.nric_note: SPOKEN_IC_DIGITS from backend/src/fixtures/spoken-identifiers.ts:18 (synthetic, born 12 Apr 1990), so the age is 36

pacing: Record takes hold 1.8 s on each on-camera target between its cue and the click (0.9 s camera move + ring), and 1.2 s after each click for the result to land.

narration.text: This is CatatMD.
It turns a GP consultation into a clinical note the doctor can review.
Everything you'll see here is synthetic: no real patient appears.
The doctor registers a patient and starts a consultation from the profile.
With the patient's consent, given for this visit only, CatatMD listens.
The transcript builds live, turn by turn,
and the safety panel suggests what to ask next.
One click analyses the visit.
Before any text leaves the server, names and identity numbers become tokens.
The model only ever sees the tokens, and the real details come back on the return trip.
The doctor reviews three panels side by side: the transcript, the structured note, and clinical safety.
Red flags come from deterministic rules first.
The model can add candidates for review, but it can never remove a rule's hit.
The checklist ties each field to the words that support it.
Suggestions cite guideline IDs from a fixed corpus, so a made-up reference cannot reach the screen.
The doctor dictates the prescription.
CatatMD parses each line into dose, frequency and duration, and saves only the lines the doctor confirms.
CatatAI answers questions about the visit, and can propose an edit.
Nothing changes until the doctor applies it.
Nothing is ever approved by default.
The doctor acknowledges the red flags and approves the note.
The finished record exports as a consultation report.
CatatMD drafts.
The doctor decides.

shots.on_camera: Landing hero for about 2 s; click Try the Demo; the Login page; click Sign In as Guest. The shot ends on the click: the app opens on a consultation list full of other visitors' patients, which never reaches the edit.
Type the film patient's name, NRIC, age and gender; Register Patient; the profile; click Start Consultation.
shots.creates: The film patient (record run only). A check run fills the form but does not submit; the record take submits once. A retake that would create a second patient waits for the Director.

shots.on_camera: Consent tick; Start Ambient Capture; Listening; the transcript builds turn by turn while the dialogue plays; the safety panel's Ask Next prompts; the live haemoptysis flag; Stop and Finish; Use Live Transcript if refinement starts; the saved transcript.

questions: In one or two plain sentences, without references: which red flag matters most here, and what should I ask next?
Add to the Plan that she should come back in three days if she is not improving.
shots.on_camera: Open CatatAI; Q1 typed and answered (retake once if a bracketed ID prints); Q2 typed; the Plan proposal card; Apply; the Plan reads You Edited This.

shots.one_shot: Approval cannot be undone: one record take.
